Lansing Bike Party

Lansing, MI · Social

Lansing Bike Party is a social group ride in Lansing, MI. It rolls every Friday at 6:30 pm from Lansing Bike Co-op. About 10–20 miles, 10–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lansing Bike Party group ride

The Lansing area's biggest weekly social ride. A laid-back cruise around the region with a rest stop or two and a stop for food and drinks, then a ride back. Music and bells are common. Bring lights.
